subject: Ops architecture kickoff & slot coordination
messages:
From: Alex Green <alex.green@mediqhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@mediqhealth.com>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Discovery summary + next steps

Hi Rishi,

Thanks for the call earlier — that was helpful. As mentioned, we want to move from discovery to a technical deep dive focused on our private/VPC requirements and how Redwood would operate inside our Azure VNet. Priya (cc'd) is our infra lead and will own the technical review.

Availability this week: I can do Thursday 10:00-11:00PT or Friday 13:00-15:00PT. Priya is only available after 14:00PT on Friday.

High-level objectives for the deep dive:
- Confirm network connectivity patterns (NAT, peering, egress policies)
- Data residency and KMS/HSM integrations
- Authentication and audit log delivery (SIEM)
- Expected throughput and burst capacity for POC (1–2 QPS sustained, occasional spikes)

Could you also share a short agenda and who from Redwood would join (solutions engineer + security/infra SME)? Finally, we have a standard security questionnaire; we can share it ahead of the call but would prefer to review live for any clarifying questions.

Regards,
Alex
Director, Platform Engineering
MediQ Health

From: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Alex Green <alex.green@mediqhealth.com>
Cc: Priya Rao <priya.rao@mediqhealth.com>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 25 Aug 2026 17:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery summary + next steps

Hi Alex — great to hear. Thanks for the clear objectives. Monica (cc'd) is our Solutions Engineer and will lead the technical deep dive. I will also ask our security SME to join for the portions about KMS/HSM and audit logs.

Proposed slots based on your listed availability:
- Thu 08/26 10:00–11:00 PT (Monica joins)
- Fri 08/27 14:00–15:00 PT (security SME confirmed)

If Friday at 14:00 PT works, that matches Priya's availability and will let us bring the security lead. If you'd prefer Thursday we can proceed with a split follow-up for the security topics.

Attached is a one-page kickoff agenda and a short note of what we typically ask customers to share ahead of a private deploy review (network CIDR ranges, KMS provider, expected concurrent sessions). If you want, send the security questionnaire and we'll pre-fill obvious fields to save time.

Next steps:
1) Confirm preferred slot (Thu 10a PT or Fri 2p PT)
2) If Fri chosen, share any current network diagrams and the questionnaire (we'll pre-review)
3) I will send calendar invite + Zoom and a short pre-read (1–2 pages)

Thanks,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference

Attachments: Redwood-Kickoff-Agenda.pdf (pdf), initial-architecture-notes.txt (text)

From: Priya Rao <priya.rao@mediqhealth.com>
To: rishi_malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, monica_patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Cc: Alex Green <alex.green@mediqhealth.com>
Date: Wed, 26 Aug 2026 09:41:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Discovery summary + next steps

Thanks — Friday 08/27 14:00 PT works best for us. A couple of notes to shape the agenda:
- Please allocate ~20 min to our network team questions; they will want to confirm egress IPs and any required firewall rules.
- We will need clear guidance on KMS options; we use Azure Key Vault but want to understand HSM requirements for SOC/PCI workloads.
- Can you also cover your audit log export cadence and formats (syslog vs. SIEM push)?

We will upload the security questionnaire by EOD Thursday and include a simplified network diagram. Looking forward to the call.

Priya
Senior Infrastructure Engineer
MediQ Health

Thanks for confirming — Friday 2026-08-27 14:00 PT is booked. Calendar invite sent with Zoom link and a short pre-read attached. Joining attendees from Redwood: Monica Patel (Solutions Engineer), Steven Cho (Security Engineer), and me.

Agenda in the invite:
- 5m: intros + objectives
- 15m: network & VNet connectivity (Monica)
- 15m: auth, KMS/HSM options (Steven)
- 10m: logging & audit exports (Steven)
- 10m: performance targets for POC and next steps (Rishi)

Pre-read attachments: Redwood-Kickoff-Agenda.pdf, initial-architecture-notes.txt

Action items captured in invite notes:
- Mediq to upload their security questionnaire (Priya)

Look forward to the discussion.

Best,
Rishi Malhotra
Account Executive — Enterprise Sales
Redwood Inference
